author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗೆಲ್ಲುತಲೆ ಹಿಗ್ಗದಿರು ಸೋಲುತಲೆ ಕುಗ್ಗದಿರು
ಮೆಲ್ಲನೇ ಬೆಳೆಸುತಿರು ಸಮಚಿತ್ತತನವ
ತಲ್ಲಣಿಸಿ ಮರುಗೆ ಜನರೇಳುಬೀಳುಗಳಿಂದ
ಸಲ್ಲುತಿರು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Do not swell when you win, nor shrink when you lose;
slowly keep growing an even mind;
when people fret and grieve over their ups and downs,
be there for them, and gently wake them, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Success and failure should not sway us. Cultivate a balanced mind, and when others are shaken by life’s ups and downs, stand by them and help them see clearly.
en.note: Kusha posted this verse again on 15 December, the day after it first appeared.
